title: Natural seabed (false-positive challenge)
description: Held-out frames containing NO annotated target: ripples, rock texture, nadir band and shadow only. Every hazard reported here is a false positive. This is the scenario PS 26057 actually cares about.
short_description: No targets present. Every hit here is a false positive.
